description: Endless golden wheat fields in North Africa under a bright blue sky. Roman-style aqueducts run through the fields. Farmers harvesting.
text_content: After the wars with Rome, North Africa became a peaceful garden. Fields of wheat stretched as far as the eye could see.

description: A diverse group of early Christians (Romans, Amazigh, others) gathered in a courtyard for a meal (Agape feast). Warm, inviting lighting.
text_content: It was here, in this rich land, that the church of Jesus began to grow like a strong tree. People of all kinds became Christians.

description: A Roman official reading a decree in a public square. Soldiers stand guard. The people look worried. Shadowy and tense atmosphere.
text_content: But the Roman Emperor wanted everyone to worship him. He didn't like the Christians because they said, 'Jesus is Lord.'

description: Perpetua in prison, talking to her elderly father. She points to a water pitcher on the floor. Her face is calm and resolute.
text_content: A young mother named Perpetua was arrested. She was very brave. Even when her father begged her to give up, she pointed to a pitcher.

description: Close up of Perpetua's face, filled with grace and strength. Soft lighting highlights her expression of faith.
text_content: 'Can you call this pitcher by any other name?' she asked. 'No,' said her father. 'In the same way, I cannot call myself anything but a Christian.'

description: A symbolic image of seeds falling into the ground and sprouting into strong green plants. In the background, the silhouette of the Roman arena.
text_content: Perpetua and her friend Felicitas gave their lives for Jesus. Their courage made the church grow even stronger. The blood of martyrs was like seed.

description: A young, troubled Augustine sitting in a garden in Milan, looking distressed. A scroll lies on the ground next to him.
text_content: Years later, a brilliant young man named Augustine lived in Africa. He made many mistakes and looked for happiness in wrong places.

description: Augustine under a fig tree. He is reading a Bible with a look of realization and peace. A light shines on the page.
text_content: But his mother, Monica, prayed for him every day. Finally, in a garden, Augustine heard a child's voice say, 'Take up and read.'

description: Bishop Augustine sitting in his study in Hippo, writing with a quill. Shelves of scrolls behind him. He looks wise and kind.
text_content: Augustine became a great Bishop. He wrote books that taught the whole world about God’s grace and the City of God.

description: The ruins of the Hippo Basilica at sunset. The stones are old, but the cross still stands or is implied in the architecture.
text_content: Enemies eventually attacked the cities of North Africa, but the wisdom of Augustine and the courage of Perpetua could never be destroyed.

description: A heavenly city shining in the clouds above the African landscape, representing the 'City of God'. Artistic and inspiring.
text_content: They remind us that the strongest kingdom is not Rome or Carthage, but the Kingdom of God.

description: A parchment map of the North African coast. It marks 'Carthage' and 'Hippo Regius'. Olive branches decorate the corners.
text_content: Map: The Coast of Saints. This map shows the cities of Carthage and Hippo along the Mediterranean Sea. The land is green and fertile.
